summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repo without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (Task.finished_time field, finished property based on it, _reset clears it, TimeElapsedColumn after the bar column, capture in Progress.update and Progress.advance inside the lock, reset clears finished_time); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with lazy imports and a TYPE_CHECKING Table import); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added entry for Progress.TimeElapsedColumn); tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast); tests/test_progress.py (new test_time_elapsed_column, import and column list updated, test_columns expected output regenerated by hand-tracing the clock: bars 33->25 and 23->16 cells, elapsed cells inserted, finished values 0:01:00 and 0:00:45, speeds recomputed to 1 byte/s, speed-column padding removed as a consequence). Not verified by running; bar widths and value substitutions were checked with grep. Deviation: BarColumn does not read task.finished, so its styling still follows completed/total. No commits made.
